methodology.purpose: Descriptive fixed-horizon attribution of price behavior after the canonical baseline exit.
methodology.referencePrice: Baseline exit price: TP1 for winners, SL for losses.
methodology.favorableExcursion: BUY: future high minus exit price; SELL: exit price minus future low, normalized by original 1R risk.
methodology.adverseExcursion: BUY: exit price minus future low; SELL: future high minus exit price, normalized by original 1R risk.
methodology.futureLeakageGuard: All post-exit metrics are labels/descriptive outcomes after exit; no future candle is used to construct a trading decision or feature.
